description: Read a contributor profile by public key: documents (at most 100), proposed edits and their review state, and inbox (open suggestions waiting for that profile). Read-only. Returns displayName, documents, contributions and inbox. Use heystack_list_my_documents to page every public document for that key. Do not use it to search documents. Review inbox items with heystack_review_suggestion.

key.description: Contributor public key. Never a private key.

name: heystack_read_profile
title: Read a profile
